observations: Photo 0 shows a Yamaha electronic keyboard with speakers on both sides and a central LCD screen.
The control panel has a visible model marking that appears to read 'PSR-175' (small text).
No close-up of ports (power/USB/MIDI), no view of keys from the side for damage, and no screen-on/playing video.

read_from: photo 0 control panel model marking (appears to read PSR-175)

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the keyboard but does not show it powered on, audio output, or any test of functions/keys.

claims.claim: it's used please note but working perfectly well
claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not confirm condition level or any functional testing; only appearance is visible.

risks.risk: Not actually working (keys, speakers, LCD, power supply, or sound engine may be faulty).
risks.proof: A short video of the keyboard powered on with the screen lit, playing a few notes, and showing volume/speaker output (or headphone output).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully proven/assume faults possible (worst case for 'working perfectly' = treat as not guaranteed working).

risks.risk: Model mismatch (could be a different Yamaha PSR model with similar layout).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the model nameplate/label and the full control panel text (including PSR number) in sharp focus.
risks.if_unproven: Price using the closest comparable Yamaha PSR/keyboard category, not assuming the exact PSR-175 value.

risks.risk: Hidden damage or wear affecting usability (stuck keys, dead keys, broken buttons/knobs, damaged casing).
risks.proof: A side-angle photo of the full keybed and a quick key-by-key test video (pressing across the keyboard).
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible wear; do not price at top end.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power adapter, sustain pedal, stand) or incompatible charger.
risks.proof: Photo of everything included: power adapter/charger label, sustain pedal (if any), and any cables/stand.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming only the keyboard is included (worst case for missing accessories).

proof_requests: Video: power ON with LCD visible + playing notes (and ideally headphone/speaker sound).
Close-up: sharp photo of the model label showing 'PSR-175' clearly.
Video or photos: full key test (no dead/stuck keys) and working buttons/knobs.
Photo: included items—power adapter/charger label, sustain pedal/stand if any.
response.reason: The photos let us identify it as a Yamaha PSR-series keyboard and it appears to be a PSR-175, but functional claims are not proven; so we price at the worst case within the matching Yamaha keyboard comparables.
